recommendation: Keep the source fix. Regenerated build artifacts should pick up the stricter ElementDefinition invariant; do not mark the related missing-reason tracker family as resolved by this commit.
issue_request: FHIR-13065 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and requested a way to explain why modifier elements are modifiers. The approved resolution added ElementDefinition.isModifierReason (0..1 string) and an invariant that the reason must be present, and may only be present, when isModifier=true.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied in svn revision 13068, represented in git as 2923983143, which added ElementDefinition.isModifierReason and a one-way invariant requiring a reason when isModifier is true. The reciprocal condition from the Jira resolution was not enforced.
additional_context: ElementDefinition is in current build scope through source/fhir.ini. FHIR-20331 later corrected the one-way FHIRPath expression to use `(isModifier.exists() and isModifier)`, but it did not supersede the original reciprocal requirement. Zulip discussion around GF#13065 confirms the post-addition sweep for missing modifier reasons, and no Confluence references or conflicting community decisions were found.
reconciliation: Updated source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml invariant 18 so the human-readable text, FHIRPath, and XPath require isModifierReason if and only if isModifier is true, preserving the FHIR-20331 corrected true-test form.
source_changes: source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml: changed ElementDefinition invariant 18 from a one-way reason-required check to a bidirectional reason-required-and-only-when-modifier check.

related_jiras.note: Later Published technical correction changed the ElementDefinition FHIRPath from a bare isModifier test to `(isModifier.exists() and isModifier)`; this fix preserves that syntax while adding FHIR-13065's reciprocal condition.
Part of the follow-up tracker family for populating missing isModifierReason values after GF#13065; it was supporting context only and was not decided here.
